questions.q: What method does Robbins suggest for improving performance by copying top achievers?
questions.why: He describes modeling top performers and emulating them.

questions.q: How did Robbins impact US army shooting scores?
questions.why: He took top shooters, analyzed them, and taught others, raising pass rate to 100%.

questions.q: According to the book, where should you look to boost memory recall?
questions.why: The classic thinking pose involves looking up and right to aid recall.

questions.q: What is the key to showing love according to the partner communication lesson?
a: Identify and use their preferred love language
questions.why: It stresses matching your partner's favorite communication style.

questions.q: What risk does Robbins warn about when ignoring a partner's love style?
questions.why: Mismatch leads to partner feeling unloved even if love is present.
